# reci

> Compile declarative CI recipes into fully-wired GitHub Actions workflows with typed data-flow validation.

- [reci.adapters.wads](_autosummary/reci.adapters.wads.html.md): WadsAdapter — reads &#96;&#91;tool.wads.ci&#93;&#96; for backward compatibility.
- [reci.adapters.yaml_adapter](_autosummary/reci.adapters.yaml_adapter.html.md): YamlAdapter — reads &#96;.ci.yml&#96; via ruamel.yaml.

- [reci.graph](_autosummary/reci.graph.html.md): Recipe DAG — computational graph built on &#96;graphlib&#96;.
- [reci.recipe](_autosummary/reci.recipe.html.md): Recipe model — declarative CI pipeline description.
- [reci.validation](_autosummary/reci.validation.html.md): Validation system — ESLint-style severity, ruff-style rule prefixes.
- [reci.validation.formatters](_autosummary/reci.validation.formatters.html.md): Output formatters for validation reports.
- [reci.validation.report](_autosummary/reci.validation.report.html.md): Core validation data structures.
- [reci.validation.rules](_autosummary/reci.validation.rules.html.md): Validation rule registry and runner.
- [reci.validation.rules.action](_autosummary/reci.validation.rules.action.html.md): Action metadata validation rules (ACT001–ACT003).
- [reci.validation.rules.config_rules](_autosummary/reci.validation.rules.config_rules.html.md): Config validation rules (CONF001–CONF003).
- [reci.validation.rules.dag](_autosummary/reci.validation.rules.dag.html.md): DAG structure validation rules (DAG001–DAG004).
- [reci.validation.rules.flow](_autosummary/reci.validation.rules.flow.html.md): Data-flow validation rules (FLOW001–FLOW006).
- [reci.validation.rules.purity](_autosummary/reci.validation.rules.purity.html.md): Purity validation rules (PURE001–PURE003).
- [reci.yaml_gen](_autosummary/reci.yaml_gen.html.md): YAML I/O wrapper using ruamel.yaml (YAML 1.2).
